method: Synthetic PCM, simulated sample clock; same 500 ms lead-in and 1000 ms tail. Vosk receives 50 ms blocks, sherpa receives 20 ms blocks. Audio times start at the lead-in, not at word end. Excluded: microphone, OS queues, computation, transport, Godot. Compute costs are measured separately. One synthetic English speaker. Parameter search uses these fixtures; it is not an independent validation set.
decision: Do not replace Vosk: no tested sherpa configuration passes all fast repetitions.
